research_notes: Initial research1 October2026. Expanded sparse official business-owner entry using government2010review, historical employer/government reports, first speech, publisher credits, contemporary profiles and reporting.22 occupational/governance/activity records are not22 additive jobs.

Historical government review is especially useful for omitted SKM2009appointment, ABC cadetship and separate Indigenous media work. Raw PDF text has encoding problems, later open404 and direct public download403; use retrieved indexed biography with explicit limits. No access controls bypassed.

Voyages classification is grounded in2019–20Commonwealth budget: wholly owned ILSC subsidiary and public non-financial corporation. Executive title and published remuneration do not establish substantive full-time status; no years calculated.

IBA2016–17and2018–19PDFs could be opened but text find did not reliably expose board biographies. Do not assign adjacent directors' appointment dates from snippets. ILSC2018–19PDF403, ILSC2019–20open failed, Adelaide annual link redirected; Auditor-General indexed comparative report supplies council cessation. GPEx and Congress2016–17open failed; indexed employer tables retained with locators. Congress2015–16PDF400content too large36799603.

Public professional profile https://au.linkedin.com/in/kerrynne-liddle-9935bb1a7 returned999Unknown Status Code. No authenticated profile evidence used. Exact hours searches mainly found advertisements for her own staff, which are not evidence of her employment fraction.

Education BA/management, MBA and AICD/fellowship credentials are not employment. First speech confirms study while working but does not resolve hours or leave. Do not infer a1987career start from rounded23years in2010.

Follow up ABC/Seven/Imparja/CAAMA personnel histories, station employer for jillaroo work, business entities and operating periods, SKM/Santos transitions, Voyages contract/full-time status, Ruston staff appointment, and complete board terms/pay. Radio and writing may overlap consultancy; avoid duplicate totals.2019–22career coverage incomplete.

Senate interests search located Liddle Sapio Trust, but asset/trust declarations are not evidence of employment or active management. Other health/arts/tertiary roles and multiple businesses referenced generally in first speech remain unidentified; no completeness claim.

Follow-up2026-10-02: historical AHL report and estimates answer establish board initial appointment, part-time classification and acting-chair assignment; IBA report resolves August2019departure. AHL biography adds SA Affordable Housing Trust directorship and identifies inaugural Aboriginal Foundation SA membership, whose duties/dates/pay remain a lead.

Santos primary EIS documents substantiate2012/2013work observations. SKM/Santos exact transition, ABC/commercial media dates and hours, consultancy periods, Voyages employment fraction and Ruston contract remain unresolved. IBA start-date search yielded unrelated neighbouring board appointments, which were not borrowed. No term-expiry date or aggregate director remuneration used as personal fact.

Follow-up2026-10-03: searched exact-name combinations for SKM, Santos, Voyages and Precise Media Management. Results repeated the already captured September2010 SKM observation, May2018 Voyages start and2005 Precise Media Management partner description; no new primary evidence fixed an employment endpoint or substantive full-time status. Secondary claims that Santos began in2011 were not substituted for an exact employer appointment record.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Recovered a contemporary9September2004university-hosted presentation that identifies Tandanya chair and first-person Indigenous-newspaper feature writing earlier in2004. Newspaper/payroll, remuneration, personal hours and intervals remain unknown; writing may overlap consultancy. GPEx2021report search index still supplies appointment narrative only; ordinary download returned HTML and pdftotext reported missing trailer/xref, so no full-report dates invented. IBA2016–17direct PDF now403; retained existing indexed facts and did not bypass restriction. IBA commencement, commercial broadcaster employers/years, SKM/Santos transitions and Voyages working fraction remain unresolved.

Follow-up2026-10-05: primary IBA indexed profile resolves12April2017board appointment; Adelaide2014report resolves1January2014Council start; SAJustice2006–07original table identifies previously unrecorded Premier’s Council for Women remuneration-entitled membership. Gazette records a Housing Trust appointment episode from14January2011; scheduled expiry retained as context, not actual departure. UniSAFebruary2006welcome is an observation rather than invented effective appointment. These are governance refinements, not additional counted employment. PDF403/404/redirect and screenshot failure limitations recorded; ABC/network/station employers and dates, SKM/Santos transition, business entities, Voyages working fraction and leave still unresolved.
